answer: Yes — count overtime pay as direct care worker compensation when calculating the share of HCBS payments going to direct care workers.

citations.quote: overtime pay is included in our definition of compensation; states should include overtime pay as compensation under 42 CFR 441.311(e)(1)(i).

gold_answer: Yes. Compensation follows the Fair Labor Standards Act definition of wages and other remuneration, and overtime pay is included.
gold_quote: Consistent with the Fair Labor Standards Act, 10, 11, 12 overtime pay is included in our definition of compensation; states should include overtime pay as compensation under 42 CFR 441.311(e)(1)(i).

judge.rationale: The answer correctly says overtime pay counts as compensation; it omits the FLSA basis but contradicts nothing, and the cited passage directly supports the claim.
